    <span class="hl-type">int</span> count,
    <span class="hl-type">double</span> ratio,
    <span class="hl-type">Integer</span> optCount,
    <span class="hl-type">Double</span> optRatio,

    <span class="hl-type">List</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">Double</span>&gt; nums
) {

    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> UserCreatedData fromMap(<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; map) {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> UserCreatedData(
            (<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;count&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Double</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;ratio&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;optCount&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Double</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;optRatio&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">List</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>&gt;) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;ints&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">List</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">Double</span>&gt;) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nums&quot;</span>)
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; toMap() {
        <span class="hl-kw">var</span> map = <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;();

        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;ratio&quot;</span>, ratio);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;optCount&quot;</span>, optCount);
